landing.h1.a: Get mothers and children to the
landing.lead: A first-contact companion for drug shops, community health workers and dispensaries. Set it up once for your country, your role and the languages your patients speak.
landing.offline.d: Questions, flags and referral codes run on the phone. Messages send when signal returns.
landing.language.d: Choose the national language for staff and the languages mothers use at home.
landing.person.d: The app flags and explains with sources. You confirm every referral.
landing.once: Takes about a minute and is saved on this phone. You can change it later in Settings.
landing.sms.label: Message to a mother
landing.sms.note: Sent in her language. No symptoms or diagnosis in the message.
landing.foot: Prototype for the World Bank Small AI for Development Hackathon. Sample data; Swahili text and clinical rules are drafts pending review.
setup.nocountry: No country matches. Try another spelling.
setup.location.note: Used to sort clinics by distance. It stays on this phone.
setup.staff: Which language should the app use for you?
setup.staff.help: National and official languages of the country.
setup.staff.pending: Translation pending: the app shows English until this language is ready.
setup.patients: Which languages do your patients speak?
setup.patients.help: Pick all that apply. At each visit you choose one, and her messages go out in it.
setup.support.full: Text, the AI and messages all work.
setup.support.ui_pending: Shows English or Swahili until translated.
setup.support.keypad_audio: Keypad answers and recorded voice prompts only.
setup.guide.ready: Localized guideline pack ready (pending clinician review).
setup.guide.who: No national pack yet. The app uses WHO defaults and marks every flag as not yet localized. A clinician must review before use.
result.mother.pending: Where to go, when, and her code appear here once you create the referral.
setup.name: Your name
setup.workid.help: Your licence, registration or staff number (e.g. ADDO-KLM-0421). It is printed on every referral you send.
setup.workid.bad: Use 3 to 30 letters or numbers (dashes, dots and slashes are fine).
setup.gps.denied: Location permission was refused. The app will find the place you typed instead.
setup.gps.failed: No GPS fix. The app will find the place you typed instead.
setup.clinics.loading: Finding real clinics near you on OpenStreetMap…
setup.clinics.ok: {n} clinics found within {km} km of {from}, nearest first. Saved on this phone for offline referrals.
setup.clinics.slots: Appointment times are simulated until clinics share their schedules.
setup.clinics.fail.sample: Could not reach the map service (no internet?). Referrals will use the sample clinics, marked Sample data, until you retry online.
setup.clinics.fail.cached: Could not reach the map service. Using the {n} real clinics saved earlier on this phone.
start.clinics.sample: Clinics: sample data (go online and open Change setup to load real clinics)
setup.areas.source: Official district list (geoBoundaries, open data). Choose from the list so names match clinic and surveillance records.
